sources.title: mechfight bot kit
sources.verification: downloaded 2026-11-21, contents in kit/ and arena/

facts.fact: Score per match is 16 - place; total is the mean over 48 practice matches vs 15 house bots (4 easy, 4 medium, 4 hard, 3 expert).
House bots share vision and hunt the weakest entrant first.
4 submissions per hour; final: top 32 practice teams play a 16-match qualifier, top 16 a 64-match series on new seeds.
Cutoff Sun Nov 22 11:00 AM ET; the chosen submission locks at cutoff.
Decision every 0.1 s, 50 ms budget; coast 1 s then idle on missed answers; 1 CPU, 512 MB, read-only fs, no network, uid 65534.
facts.verification: doc; sandbox check passes with these flags

facts.fact: Mech 1400 HP, regen 45 HP/s after 5 s without dealing or taking damage, rear hits x1.5 outside a 180 degree front arc.
facts.verification: verified in hello.config of the recorded match

facts.fact: Laser: 315 damage hitscan at full 0.75 s charge, 280 m range, 1.65 s cooldown; charging is visible to opponents.
facts.verification: verified: three 315 laser hits from 150 m in the recorded match

facts.fact: Gun: 45 damage, 252 m/s, 0.24 s cooldown, mag 12, reload 2.4 s, range 230 m, spread 0.6 degrees.
Zone: radius 560 -> 380 -> 240 -> 140 -> 70 -> 25 -> 0 m, dps 20/35/60/100/160/260; hold/shrink windows in config.zone.phases.
Vision 200 m in a 120 degree yaw wedge plus 45 m all round; tracked for 5 s after leaving view. Gun sound carries 320 m.

assumptions.assumption: obs.zone.center/radius are the phase-start circle, interpolated linearly during the shrink window.
assumptions.status: unverified; bot interpolates, which is the safer reading if they are already current

assumptions.assumption: House bots react to our gunfire sounds, so unprovoked long-range shooting attracts them.
Standing still is safest between rotations (no step sounds under 5 m/s).
assumptions.status: doc says silent; effect on house bots unverified

assumptions.assumption: Mechs can stand on building roofs (prism tops) and reach them by jumping and jetting into the wall.
assumptions.status: doc says so (section 7 Movement: 'almost every campus roof'); not observed in the recorded match, which has no rooftop positions

assumptions.assumption: A roof position improves survival against the house bots.
assumptions.status: unverified; it is the v3 hypothesis the board will test

measurements.result: 468/469 recorded mech positions on walkable cells; terrain error < 6 mm
13th place; lost ~950 HP to laser shots from 150 m answered with the gun

submissions.note: strafing + positional play (v2 was never scored alone). Best so far; entered in the final
bundled cover-first combat + 130 m laser detour + speed fix, against the one-change rule; cannot attribute the drop. wait fell 143 -> 46 ms, consistent with the speed fix working

roof perching off. The submission raced a merge of try-b/c/d/e + sim into main (last merge 11:23:22 ET), so it may have built the bundle. Roof versions 3.52 / 3.69 vs no-roof 3.21 / 2.96: perching likely helps. main restored to v3.1.

plan: v3.3 (main): v3.1 + no crate shooting (one change).
